suite.name: Uncalibrated cross-region hydraulic-data diagnostics
suite.purpose: Expose model error across regions and data sources without selecting parameters from validation scores.

dataset_hierarchy.label: Surveyed cross-sections or topobathymetric lidar
dataset_hierarchy.role: Preferred channel, bank, floodplain, and submerged-bed geometry
dataset_hierarchy.limitations: Coverage is sparse and survey dates must bracket the event.

dataset_hierarchy.label: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM
dataset_hierarchy.role: Preferred U.S. bare-earth floodplain terrain when bathymetry is absent
dataset_hierarchy.limitations: Does not normally resolve submerged channel bathymetry.

dataset_hierarchy.label: NOAA/USGS integrated topobathymetric DEM
dataset_hierarchy.role: Preferred public terrain where an integrated product exists
dataset_hierarchy.limitations: Geographically limited; vertical datum and survey epoch must be checked.

dataset_hierarchy.label: ANADEM regional bare-earth DEM
dataset_hierarchy.role: South America fallback when higher-resolution reviewed terrain is absent
dataset_hierarchy.limitations: Too coarse for many channels, levees, culverts, and local bank controls.

dataset_hierarchy.label: GEDTM30 global bare-earth DEM
dataset_hierarchy.limitations: Screening-grade only; requires conditioning and independent verification.

interpretation_guard: Differences between unrelated rivers confound dataset and river physics. Only paired cases on the same event can isolate a dataset substitution.

paired_comparisons.name: Rio Grande proxy versus measured cross-sections
paired_comparisons.changed: channel geometry, bed slope, and roughness evidence
paired_comparisons.interpretation: This paired structural test is the only current comparison that can isolate a hydraulic-data substitution. It remains retrospective because the field visits postdate the event.
paired_comparisons.finding: The hydraulic-data substitution did not resolve the event error; investigate forcing, controls, reach processes, and model structure.

cases.name: Glen Canyon Dam to Lees Ferry — 2004-07-01

hydraulic_dataset.label: Assumed constant reach geometry
hydraulic_dataset.role: Legacy geometry proxy below the preferred hierarchy
hydraulic_dataset.limitations: Cannot distinguish terrain error from channel-shape assumptions.

volume_only_counterfactual.guard: Uses held-out downstream volume as an oracle diagnostic. It is not a permissible forcing correction or calibration.
